details.optimizer_message: Return from COBYLA because the objective function has been evaluated MAXFUN times.
notes: QAOA samples a biased probability distribution. It does not enumerate the search space and gives no optimality guarantee.

The cost operator was divided by its largest coefficient before building the circuit. That is a monotone rescaling, so it leaves the ordering of all solutions and the location of the optimum unchanged; all reported values use the original unscaled QUBO.
Constraints are penalties inside the QUBO, so an infeasible sample is an expected outcome rather than a bug.
qiskit_algorithms.QAOA is deliberately not used: it was measured to scale pathologically on this version combination (>200s at 11 qubits versus 0.064s per sampler call).
